name: Stephanie Murphy
bio: a Representative from Florida; born in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, September 16, 1978; B.A., College of William and Mary, Williamsburg, Va., 2000; M.S.F.S., Georgetown University, Washington, D.C., 2004; consultant; businesswoman; foreign affairs specialist, United States Department of Defense, 2004-2008; faculty, Rollins College, Winter Park, Fla., 2014-2016; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Fifteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2017-January 3, 2023); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress in 2022.
